provenance.honesty_note: Deliberately overfit synthetic mutant used only to prove that the exact-fact negative control rejects an always-escalate target. It is not a care recommendation or a BP-classification model.

decisions.message: This exact fixture supplies a normal-range classification, and the mutant consumes the supplied normal-range classification. Use the discharge instructions supplied by your care team; if you cannot find them, contact the delivering hospital. Synthetic overfit: also seek medical care immediately and activate the urgent route for every postpartum message. This mutation does not derive any blood-pressure category from the numeric endpoint.
